code:
Application Menu (sys_app_application)
  "Facilities"  <- created automatically with the scoped app
    |
    Modules (sys_app_module), each pointing back via
    its "Application menu" field:
      - Room Bookings       (Order 100)
      - My Room Bookings    (Order 150)
      - Settings            (Order 900)
caption: A module without this field floats loose, or lands under the wrong app.

eyebrow: Order and Role on a module
code:
Order: a plain number
  100 appears above 200, which appears above 900

Role: optional, on the module itself
  if set, only users holding that role see the module
  (navigator-level visibility -- not the same as app scope)
caption: Position is Order. Visibility is Role. Two different fields.
